rows.why: Eight windows adopt one four-state model and one attribute contract; the per-window floors live in one table.
Exactly seven identity fields. The subscription weight rule is enforced by the projection rather than by review.
A route is the (account, model) pair. One catalog, so the same model under two accounts is two identities everywhere.

rows.role: Access profile ladder and mode narrowing
rows.why: One narrowing table and one effective line, so the composer and the selector cannot disagree.
Approvals, material warnings, cross-project grants and operational conflicts share one record shape and one renderer contract.
First view shows one consequence; the rest stay as evidence. One ranked list rather than per-callsite judgement.
Extends the Lens rather than replacing it. Two closed kind lists, so a new row type is a deliberate change.
One operation, one receipt, and no rewrite of stored history or Usage.
Request, spawn, branch, rewind, restore and redirect in one module with typed refusals.
The only reader that can cross a thread boundary, and it throws rather than truncating.
A projection of the Goal Runtime, never a second Goal system.
One gate before one switch. An unimplemented verb returns false instead of showing a toast.
A compact forecast, not a guarantee, and a required role can never be silently dropped.
Thread-local by construction; members carry routes so Usage can attribute them.
One Environment surface with six compact groups. No host banner anywhere in Chat.
Five human-readable states in one place, so no concept invents a sixth or shows an underscored enum.
One transform table and one lineage rule; derived material always keeps its origin.
Mark before dispatch. The idempotency property lives in one function.
Two axes that never derive from each other, so a network blink is not reported as a failed run.
The only progress system. Every indefinite animation names a running op through data-pmx-op.
Ten skip categories exported as one function so each is directly assertable, and no text is ever replaced automatically.
Title bar only. The module states the correct alternative so nobody reaches for it for a local outcome.

rows.module: shared/motion.js — 13 transition families plus 7 causal primitives
rows.why: Reduced motion handled in one place; the eight concepts compose named helpers instead of hand-rolled timings. The seven causal primitives (displace, firstVisit, countMorph, groupReopen, phaseHandover, chainRoll, resizeBounce) are the second half of that and were added from the reference recordings: they name a CAUSE — this moved because that arrived — where the thirteen families name a transition. Keeping them in one module is what let a single CSS defect be found and fixed once for all eight concepts rather than eight times, and it is why `resizeBounce` could be given PMConcept7's measured curve in one place.
One state machine and one frame descriptor per window; the body renderer knows data kinds, not placement.

rows.justification: One record of the activity run - entry order, running phase, partial counts, disclosed phase - consumed by eight concepts that each render it in their own idiom. Written because the run state was previously duplicated between view.surfaces and PMXOpCard with no mechanism keeping the two equal, so an operation card and the capsule beside it could disagree about whether the same phase was still running.
